learner.main_idea: The Moon seems to change shape because we see different parts of the side that is lit by the Sun as it moves around Earth, but the Moon itself never actually changes shape.
how_it_works_steps: The Sun shines light onto the Moon.
The Moon sends that light back toward Earth (the Moon reflects the light).
The Moon travels around Earth in a big loop.
As the Moon moves, a different part of its sunlit side faces Earth.
The change in the lit part we see makes the Moon look like it is changing shape; those different looks are called moon phases.
